wildfire_rule: D-073b: "wildfire" only inside the exact phrase "conditions that favour wildfire" (as in the broader-hazard phrase); "wildfire" anywhere else, "fires" and "burned area" are never written.
rung_instruction: Rung 8 (hazard impact on infrastructure). Write the answer in three parts: (1) the hazard change at the place, as projected, in the table-pattern sentence; (2) for the impact groups, '<scope phrase> that <hazard phrase> <impact mechanism> <asset class phrase>', where the hazard phrase is the broader-hazard phrase when a cited impact group has hazard_relation broader_hazard, else the plain quantity; the driver groups as in any item; the general closing clause when no cited group is state- or NCA-specific; (3) never state that an asset, or the asset class, in the place will fail, is at risk, is vulnerable or will be damaged. Only when citing a group listed in place_named_impact_group_ids may the answer write 'For <asset class phrase> in <Place>, this implies more exposure to <impact outcome>'.
